title: A Different Sandwich
summaryZh: L1 延伸：在美國咖啡店，想買的材料售完了。練習聽出否定、問替代餐點，再完成點餐。建議先學「外帶午餐」。金額為美元。

learning.objectiveZh: 聽出原本的餐點沒有了，詢問替代餐點並確認選擇。外帶與付款是複習。

vocabulary.en: Food made with a filling between pieces of bread.
An oval object laid by a bird, often eaten as food.
A liquid added to food for flavor.
To take food away and eat it elsewhere.

task.setupZh: 這次你原本想買蛋三明治，但蛋沒有了。試著改點起司三明治，不要醬、外帶。先完成改點，再練其餘需求。

steps.partner: Sorry, we don't have any eggs today.
steps.promptZh: 問店員有沒有起司三明治。

steps.partner: Yes, we do. Would you like one?
steps.promptZh: 確認要一份，而且不要加醬。

steps.partner: Of course. For here or to go?

success: 我有詢問另一種餐點，並確認改點起司。
我有說清楚不要醬與外帶。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一份起司三明治，謝謝。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sorry, we don't have any cheese today.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我們今天沒有起司了。
sentences.note: 留意 don't：店員說沒有，不是有。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: To go. How much is it?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. Please tap your card here.
sentences.zh: 可以，請把卡靠近這裡感應。

questions.explanationZh: 店員說 don't have any cheese，沒有的是起司。
No sauce, please. 表示不要加醬。

questions.q: 顧客選擇哪種付款方式？
questions.explanationZh: 顧客問能否刷卡，店員請他感應卡片。
